quests.crisisScene: A spider has scared a child in the backyard, but no one has been bitten. Input code!
quests.question: Select the correct emergency dispatch action for this situation:
options: Ignore the situation completely since it is taking place outside your own property.
Scream loudly in the street while running in circles to incite mass panic.
COMFORT THE CHILD AND CHECK FOR A BITE, NO SERVICE NEEDED
quests.correctAnswer: COMFORT THE CHILD AND CHECK FOR A BITE, NO SERVICE NEEDED
quests.explanation: Being frightened isn't the same as being hurt. Checking for a bite is enough, and no emergency service is needed.

quests.crisisScene: A toddler has swallowed a small button battery from a toy. Input medical code!
quests.question: Select the correct emergency dispatch action for this situation:
options: CALL FOR MEDICAL HELP IMMEDIATELY
Take a smartphone video from across the street and wait for someone else to call.
Pull the entire municipal electrical transformer lever without authorization.
quests.correctAnswer: CALL FOR MEDICAL HELP IMMEDIATELY
quests.explanation: A button battery can cause serious internal injury within hours, so it needs urgent medical attention even without visible symptoms.

quests.crisisScene: A teenager has a mild nosebleed after being hit by a ball during a game. Input code!

options: Search online medical blogs for an hour before taking any physical action.

quests.correctAnswer: SIT HIM FORWARD AND PINCH HIS NOSE, CALL ONLY IF IT WON'T STOP
quests.explanation: A mild nosebleed after a knock usually stops with pressure and leaning forward. Bleeding that won't stop would need help.

quests.crisisScene: A warehouse worker has a forklift roll onto his foot and he can't move it. Input medical code!

quests.correctAnswer: EVACUATE AND CALL FOR HELP

quests.explanation: Knowing exactly how many people are trapped helps dispatch the right number of responders and equipment.
